summary: All requested tests PASSED. (1) CORE E2E bus recross: 2 events for the SAME track id 1, opposite directions (Entry + Exit) — verifying the reported bug (only-one-count-per-track) is fixed. AI tier was 'accurate' (yolov8s.pt) at 134 ms/frame. (2) Options API: detector_model set/reject-bogus/clamp confidence all correct. (3) Pytest: 14/14 passed (test_detection_strength.py + test_capture_fixes.py). (4) UI quick check: 3 model options present, selecting 'accurate' fires toast and /api/state.detector_model=='accurate'. Confidence slider is a shadcn (non-native) slider so scripted value-set didn't move it, but backend confidence API is verified. Cleanup executed and service restored with admin/9xsecurity.
critical_code_review_comments: Old camera_log lines showed one earlier 'SNAPSHOT SAVE FAILED ([Errno 20] Not a directory)' from a prior temp-dir run — non-blocking but suggests snapshot dir isn't ensured when config.snap_dir is a file-like temp path.
must_change_password flag re-appears after service restart even after POST /api/settings {new_password:...}; not covered by request but may confuse users on second login.
test_credentials: admin / 9xsecurity (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md); Temp123456 used transiently in UI test and reverted.
seed_data_creation: Built /app/9x_security/_gate_test.mp4 (bus recross scenario) — removed during cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end: same track produced Entry+Exit events (~2 min 45s apart in run) with vehicle_type=='bus' both times. AI ran on yolov8s.pt (ai_tier='accurate', ai_ms=134). Options endpoint clamps confidence to [0.15,0.9] and ignores bogus detector_model values. UI dropdown 'detector-model-select' has data-testid; toast appears with data-testid 'toast'. Confidence slider is shadcn — to test in Playwright, use keyboard arrows on focused slider or dispatch pointer events, not `.value=`.
rca of the issue: Original bug: tracker used tr.counted flag so a track that never left camera view could cross the line only once. Fix in tracker.py disarms track after crossing until bottom-center moves >= hysteresis px past line and requires >= 3s gap; label voting biases truck/bus. Verified: bus track_id=1 produced both an Entry and an Exit event in the same run.
